figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Crystal structures and active sites of PeTS3-BTAC-PPi-Mg2+ (wheat) and apo-PeTS3 (teal). (A) Overall structure of PeTS3-BTAC-PPi-
Mg2+ aligned with that of apo-PeTS3. The pink arrows shows the obvious spatial differences of helices C, H, and I between PeTS3-BTAC-PPi-Mg2+
and apo-PeTS3; (B) interactions among Mg2+ ions (green balls), pyrophosphate, and active site residues; (C) structural differences of loop 246−
253 and residues 324−330 between PeTS3-BTAC-PPi-Mg2+ and apo-PeTS3; (D) conformation transfer of loop 246−253 in PeTS3-BTAC-PPi-
Mg2+ (wheat, closed state) and apo-PeTS3 (teal, open state); (E) GC/MS analysis of mutations on Gln248 and Arg252. The compound 1*
(elemol) is the Cope rearrangement product of compound 1 [(+)-hedycaryol]. Compound 5 is eudesmane-2,11-diol; (F) interactions of RY dyad
with PPi and Asp107; interactions (blue) are shown as dashed lines. Key distances (Å) are shown as blue numbers.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Key intermediates captured from QM/MM calculations toward product 1 or 5 (A) and site-directed mutagenesis analyses located at (B)
Tyr172, Cys197, and Gly198; (C) Tyr312; (D) His84; and (E) Ser202. Energy values (kcal/mol) relative to model IM-A are given in parentheses,
and energy barriers are indicated above the white arrows. Crucial residues involved in each step are highlighted in wheat, while other residues are
displayed in white. Carbon atoms carrying a formal charge are rendered in green; acyclic sesquiterpene 6 is nerolidol. The production of
compounds 1 and 5 formed by wild-type PeTS3 (WT) is assigned as 100% for defining the relative production. The asterisk (*) represents the
proportion of dihydroxy terpene 5 in total terpenes produced by either PeTS3 or its variants. The data for inactivated variants are not displayed.
The detailed data are shown in Table S9.
